page0.text:
"Ngh, hah!"
I step towards Zouken and swing the kyousaku stick with all my strength.
I aim a vertical slash from skull to groin,
but something repels it, immediately sending me flying backward.

page1.text:
"Argh!"
My back slams into a wall.
I can't breathe, like someone punched the wind out of me.
My back feels numb where it hit the wall, like when you get too close to a fire.

page2.text:
I hear bugs near my ear.
The bugs coating the wall moved so that they wouldn't be crushed when I hit it.
...Even their chittering seems to taunt me.

page3.text: "You made it back in time, Assassin. I'll let you dispose of the boy. It should be an easy job compared to Saber, so take your time and enjoy it."

page4.text:
Zouken disappears.
In the darkness where he lurked,
a white skull snickers at me.

page5.text:
...So that's the Assassin Servant.
He's a black-robed killer with a white mask that suits Zouken well.

page6.text:
...
He's going to kill me.
My left hand hurts.
I can barely think.
My heartbeat reaches a fever pitch, realizing these are my last moments.
Assassin hurls lethal weapons at my groin, throat, heart, and stomach, and I have no way to stop them.
Silver light repels the incoming attack.
A blade bats aside all four daggers that were about to kill me.

page7.text:
...
Only one person could have done that.
My left hand still hurts.
My Command Spells aren't gone yet.
That means...

page8.text:
"Saber!"
"Did you fail to finish her, you fool!?"

page9.text:
I look up.
Someone appears as if to protect me from the white-masked Servant, but it's...
"Huh?"
"Hm?"
Another Servant in dark clothes, like Assassin.

page10.text:
"Rider...?"
...
There's no doubt about it.
That's Shinji's Servant, Rider.
Why is she here to help me?

page11.text:
"You would dare disobey me!? Damn it. They mean nothing to me, Assassin! Kill all who would stand in my way!"
The skull answers Zouken's shout.

page12.text:
Her long hair traces through the air.
Rider wordlessly turns toward Assassin,
facing the rain of daggers he unleashes.

page13.text: I can't follow the daggers with my eyes.

page14.text:
The skull mask bounds and scrambles around the cramped shrine room.
As soon as I spot him on the walls, he's on the ceiling, then the floor, throwing one dagger after another.
They come from every direction without end, giving their target no chance to block or evade them all.

page15.text:
In the blink of an eye, the volley of daggers lines the floor like a sharp forest.
Rider can't deal with that.
I've seen her move when she fought Saber.
Assassin's assault was probably fierce enough to keep Saber at bay.
But she beat Rider in a single blow, so Rider has no chance.

page16.text:
The white skull hurls a merciless barrage of darts.
But then, I notice...
Something like frustration behind his attacks.

page17.text:
"Wha..."
By the time I realize what's wrong, the difference in power is already clear.
...They aren't hitting her.
Not a single one of the dozens of daggers from the shadows even scratches Rider.

page18.text:
"daMN YoU..."
The voice comes from the ceiling.
Assassin glares hatefully at his foe. Maybe he ran out of daggers.
There...

page20.text:
...
...I don't believe it.
That many daggers.
Rider evaded them all with pure speed.

page21.text:
It's not like when she saved me, moments earlier.
She simply raced around on the ground, as if to declare that she didn't even need to block the daggers to defend herself.

page22.text:
"What are you playing at, Assassin!? There's no need to show mercy against my grandchild's Servant! Hurry up and take care of this!"
"I CAN'T Do tHAt. she'S dIFFerENt tHaN BefoRe."

page23.text:
Assassin eyes Rider dubiously from the ceiling.
Rider is different from the Servant I witnessed before.
The magical energy in her body and the sheer physical prowess are on a totally different level.
She might not be as strong as Saber, but she's clearly superior to Assassin.

page24.text:
"Kh... How..."
...
Rider doesn't answer.
She just crouches low.

page25.text:
Just as I realize it's the posture of a predator about to pounce on its prey,
Rider flies up at the ceiling while Assassin leaps at the ground, and they cross blades.

page26.text:
"Keh!"
...
Both fighters clash their daggers and land, facing away from each other.
Rider is unharmed.
Meanwhile, Assassin's shoulder is skewered by one of her daggers.

page27.text:
"Heh. Fool—ngh!?"
Assassin attempts to pull out the dagger in his shoulder.

page28.text:
...
Before he can, a metallic sound
of chains rings out, and Rider...
"Eh? Whaaaaa!?"
...uses her chains to bodily swing Assassin around!

page29.text:
"Gah, geeeeeh!"
The skull shrieks in pain.
Rider just keeps spinning him around mercilessly.

page30.text:
Like she's swinging a ball and chain.
Assassin flails through the room helplessly, crashing through walls, his arms and legs bending at wrong angles with each impact.

page31.text:
"Whoa, watch it!"
I duck to avoid the whirling man-tornado.

page32.text:
"Gah! Kah! Gah!"
It can't be described as merely "powerful" or "violent."
After spinning him around as she pleases, she lets the centrifugal force carry him and lets go.
It's like throwing a sledgehammer.

page33.text: Assassin, his bones shattered, is thrown through the last wall headfirst...

page34.text:
"Ah."
...and goes flying.
The skull-masked Servant is tossed out into the temple yard like a piece of trash, bounces off the ground a few times spattering blood everywhere, and finally rolls to a stop at the mountain gate.

page35.text:
"Ah...wow..."
...That was brutal.
I know by now that Servants don't die that easily, but he probably can't fight anymore.

page36.text:
"You fool..."
Zouken's presence fades.
Sensing the tables turning, the old mage departs with a harsh word for Rider,
and the bugs that were cowering in the corners of the room leave with their master.
